peace, what God has given us is Himself. And isn't that what all the best dads do?
They give themselves to their kids. They give their children confidence by giving them themselves,
by being with them. Friends, this is our God. And there is no better Father than our God
and the Lord Jesus Christ, you have grace and peace in Him and that is enough no
matter what today is He your Father? Oh He can be if you'll put your faith in His
Son. Would you join me in prayer? Heavenly Father, we ask that you would give us eyes to see you as
Father through your Son Jesus Christ. We ask that all those things that get in the way that would
cause us to mistrust or distrust you would be revealed by your spirit to be the lies that they
are, that instead we would see you most clearly revealed at the cross as the
loving Father that you are, and that our faith and our hope would be holy in you,
so that we would live as your children, not anxious, confident, and thankful for
all that you've given us. And we pray this in Christ's name. Amen.
